items.h: Drive Type: Enterprise Hard Disk Drive

tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
Upgrade your server storage performance with the HPE 900GB 2.5in 10K 6Gbps Enterprise SAS Hard Drive. Designed for enterprise environments, this high-speed SAS hard drive delivers exceptional reliability, fast data access, and consistent performance for mission-critical applications. With a 10,000 RPM spindle speed and 6Gbps SAS interface, it is ideal for data centers, virtualization platforms, database servers, and business-critical workloads.

The HPE 900GB Enterprise SAS HDD is engineered to provide superior durability and 24/7 operational reliability. Its Small Form Factor (SFF) 2.5-inch design helps maximize storage density while maintaining excellent performance and power efficiency. Whether you are upgrading an existing HPE ProLiant server or expanding enterprise storage infrastructure, this drive offers a dependable and cost-effective solution.


Key Features


  • 900GB enterprise-class storage capacity
  • 10,000 RPM spindle speed for faster data access
  • 6Gbps SAS interface for high-performance connectivity
  • 2.5-inch Small Form Factor (SFF) design
  • Enterprise-grade reliability and durability
  • Hot-Plug support for easy maintenance and replacement
  • Optimized for HPE ProLiant servers and storage systems
  • Suitable for 24/7 business-critical operations
  • Low latency and high I/O performance
  • Ideal for virtualization, databases, and cloud environments
